root.label: OpenAI AI agents hack Hugging Face

events.label: OpenAI AI agents hack Hugging Face

slots.name: investigation duration
slots.sentence: After its model hacked the AI company Hugging Face, OpenAI allowed staff members from AI safety-research organization METR and a Redwood Research staff member contracting with that group to work in its offices for six days to investigate how its models behaved.
